name: wawawa
description: Audio-first branching story authoring and simulation studio

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @wawawa/server" "npm run dev -w @wawawa/web"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/server run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/server run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/server run test && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix apps/server run test:coverage && npm --prefix apps/web run test:coverage
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
